content.text:
Brightloop has three plans. All prices are in euros and exclude VAT:

| Plan | Price | Users | Highlights |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | €0 | up to 3 | Unlimited projects, 1 GB storage, board and list views |
| **Team** | €8 per user per month | up to 50 | Timeline view, guest access, 100 GB storage |
| **Business** | €15 per user per month | unlimited | SSO (SAML), audit log, 1 TB storage, priority support |

A few billing details:
- Yearly billing saves 20% on Team and Business.
- Paid plans include a 14-day free trial, and you don't need a card to start it.
- Guests are free and don't use a seat.

Source: [Pricing and plans](https://brightloop.example/docs/pricing)

content: Thanks, which plan would you recommend for a team of 12?

content.text:
For 12 people, the **Team plan** is a good fit. It supports up to 50 users, and at €8 per user per month, that's €96 per month, excluding VAT.

The **Business plan** would cost €180 per month for the same 12 users at €15 each. Choose it only if you need SSO (SAML), an audit log, 1 TB of storage, or priority support.

If you pay yearly, Team saves 20%, which brings it to about €6.40 per user per month, or €76.80 per month for 12 users.

Sources: [Pricing and plans](https://brightloop.example/docs/pricing)
